title: Fugitive Love (Fugit Amor)
credit_line: Lent by Iris & B. Gerald Cantor Foundation
exhibition: Rodin: The Human Experience—Selections from the Iris and B. Gerald Cantor Collections
description: Two intertwined figures seem to move in opposite directions. Developed in connection with The Gates of Hell, this group turns bodily closeness into an image of passing or unreturned love. The scanned bronze was lent by the Cantor Foundation for Portland Art Museum’s 2017 Rodin exhibition.
